March 15, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
First Financial Bank – Trust Division increased its stake in Accenture Plc Ie Ireland (ACN) by 5.09% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Financial Bank – Trust Division bought 2,382 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.21% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 49,187 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.64 million, up from 46,805 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Financial Bank – Trust Division who had been investing in Accenture Plc Ie Ireland for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $100.59B market cap company. The stock increased 1.31% or $2.11   $163.11. About 901,328 shares traded. Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) has risen 4.27%   uptrending. It has underperformed by 12.43% the S&P500. 
Independent Investors Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 1.33% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 387,183 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $59.67 million, down from 392,383 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
